initialization.neural_encoding: actual normalized two-channel input; no theta round-trip

numerical_policy.arithmetic_assumptions: finite CPU float32, round-to-nearest, nonzero operands/results normal, no overflow, source-pinned sum-of-72-squares then scalar mean

reporting.commit: journal fsync then bounded atomic fsynced anchor
reporting.corruption: reject; no repair, implicit recovery or resume
reporting.offline_finalization: read-only selected input hashes; fresh separate output; explicit prefix-only diagnostic
reporting.scientific_completion: all frozen matrix/admission/control/work/endpoint checks and execution seal required
reporting.shutdown: bounded execution seal, no whole-report serialization or chain scan

hashing.freeze: caller supplies exact file hash; no self/commit hash
hashing.readiness: separately hash-selected DAG input; does not reference freeze hash

arithmetic_runtime.binary_identity_limit: Source/runtime/probe evidence, not a binary build-identity proof

original_source.approved_AST_change: compute_radiance: specular denominator valid_counts -> M_spec; all other statements unchanged

resource_budget.capacity_scope: One run plus a separate same-filesystem offline report; enforced journal/diagnostic/report caps; safety reserve equal to subtotal

memory.unmeasured: Simultaneous shader autograd/allocator/OS behavior. Sum double-counts measured base/runtime/models deliberately; original live RSS guard and8GiB AS backstop remain mandatory.
